title: human-gate feedback batch (batch.v1)
description: One round of batched human review feedback, produced by feedback_parser.py from a review sidecar and consumed by human_gate.py.

target.description: Basename of the artifact under review.

reviewer.description: Named human reviewer. Empty fails gate rule G3 — approval belongs to a person, not a team.

approved.description: True only when an APPROVE item exists AND no BLOCKER/MAJOR item is open. Absence of blockers alone is not approval.

blocking_open.description: Count of open BLOCKER + MAJOR comment items. Non-zero fails gate rule G2.

overall_note.description: Unanchored commentary from ## NOTE sections, joined by blank lines.

id.description: Stable within a round: f1, f2, ...

kind.description: comment = a change request; edit = a verbatim replacement the reviewer already wrote; approve = explicit sign-off.

severity.description: BLOCKER/MAJOR block the gate. Google Code Review Developer Guide ladder; matches markdown-html/md-review.

block.description: Block anchor id assigned by review_page_builder.py (b1, b2, ...). Empty for unanchored items.

quote.description: Verbatim text the reviewer selected. Checked against the artifact by feedback_parser.py --target; a mismatch is reported as a problem, not silently ignored.

feedback.description: What needs to change, and why.

before.description: EDIT items only: the exact current text.

after.description: EDIT items only: the reviewer's exact replacement. MUST be carried across verbatim — never paraphrased, never reverted, and applied to the generating source as well as the rendered artifact.
